annotation: Assistant manually transcribed readable selected targets from source frames BEFORE inference. Not independently reviewed. Selected target recall only; not exhaustive precision or camera acceptance. Training overlap unknown. No rain footage obtained. These clips also exposed and were used to fix motion association; they are a development regression set, not a held-out benchmark.
protocol: All frames sampled at 5 Hz; max side 1280, detector 640 FP32, confidence 0.35, same OCR and conservative 3-of-7 temporal policy. Evaluate full frame and the predefined ROI separately. No model weight or detector confidence tuning on these clips; motion association was debugged using their trajectories.
